steps.text: 12:10 P.M. \ Clear
Rhodes Island Cafeteria

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Auntie, I'd like a mushroom meal set—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: With extra berry jam and bean paste, thank you.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Whew.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Pff... Pff... That's hot...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh, if it isn't Durin. Mind if I have a seat?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Sure, no problemo~

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Appreciate it. It's pretty packed around this time, and just about everywhere is filled up.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You by yourself? Where's ol' Rangers, and Yato's crew?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I came here first.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Training just ended, so they're still cleaning up. We're about to go get some barbecue.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Huh? If you're going to have barbecue, why'd you order that mushroom combo?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: It's fiiine. This tiny portion's basically just a quick little snack—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Ahhh——mm.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (Takes a huge bite and starts chewing)

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Wait... am I seeing things?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: There was a whole plate of food in front of you just three seconds ago, and now half of it's gone?! Shouldn't you slow down?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Heh heh, that's nothing.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: The food on the surface is really different from the stuff back home. I'm already going slow enough to taste it.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Ahh, but mushrooms are delicious no matter how you cook them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Yeah, we all know how much you love fungus by now.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Real talk though, aren't you worried about getting malnourished, always eating the same kind of food?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Nooope.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Whew, that hit the spot. All finished here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Huuuh? Wait, when'd you finish eating... I told you, you eat way too fast. Are you sure you're alright?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Yes, I'm fine. Don't worry.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I can eat even faster... But, Medical chewed me out when I had that speed-eating contest with Noir Corne, so I've been taking it easy the last couple days.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What the heck do you guys do for fun?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: You know, normal stuff. It's totally fine.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: *Yawn*... Eating always makes me sleepy. The others sure are taking their sweet time...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I'll go grab a drink to perk myself up—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (Hmm, I still have some leftover fruit drinks from last time.)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (But it's too far to go back to the lounge... *Yawn*... and I'm getting a bit sleepy...)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (Oh, right, there should be some coffee in the common room now, right?)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: What's with the racket?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Ugh, who's that over there...?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Gah. Such a beautiful afternoon, but some people don't know to appreciate it.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: I feel the convulsions of an evil power... Hey, big guy, control yourself, stop—

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Wait, hey, stop it, bro, are you trying to hurt me?!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Who the hell did this? Installing such a huge machine and mounting it with such dangerous heavy weaponry!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: 'ello.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Dammit, how could this happen?! The mist of evil will spread if this is allowed to continue!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Haah... Left with no other choice, I must resort to the techniques that I swore to seal away...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Um...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Hmph, I should've known. The trembling of my arm was an omen of this moment.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Hey, big guy, don't hate me for this, but I will show you the path...
The pint-sized Durin jumps up wordlessly and delivers a precise kick to the calf of the red-haired Vouivre.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Whose dark mach— Gah, you, you're from A4...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I said, you've been reaaaaally— freaking— loooooud—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: What are you doing here anyway, hmm? Reenacting Red Hair-zilla versus Giant Robot?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Red Hair... what?! Don't go ascribing me a title that reeks of a cheap, shitty flick!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Ugh, no, now isn't the time for this! Get back, and stand behind me. Beware of the evil power emanating from— Hey, stop messing around!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: What a pain.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Times like these call for...... Take this!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Hold on! Stimulating the sleeping beast invites only disaster... Wait, wait, I already said, don't just start throwing Arts at it! If you trigger the automatic counterattack mechanism, things might get incredibly dangerous—

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Huh...? The titan is slowing down?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Heh heh, direct hit.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Phew... *Yawn*... So sleepy. Welp, the rest is up to you.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hurry, open up the cover under the big guy's robotic arm. The main control box is probably somewhere in there.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Wha... Oh... Huh?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Do you know how to work it? If not, hmm... maybe we can just blow it up.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hurry, don't just stand there staring. That place I just hit~

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: If you keep gawking, you're gonna be eating shells real soon.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Stop pushing me.. Tsk, fine, I got it!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Heh, this god-given power is not something that should be casually revealed, but today, I'll make an exception and allow you to bear witness! Don't underestimate me... dealing with machines that stink of oil is my specialty!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: You might have a little bit of gumption, big guy, but you still lack refinement! Heed me and come to a halt!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Uhh... I actually wanted to ask you something.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Don't you feel embarrassed at all saying stuff like that?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: None of your business!!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Phew... At least that's taken care of.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Now, who was the arrogant fool who put together such a dangerous piece of power armor and even equipped it with weapons? Hah, lucky I was here.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (Hmm, let me see...)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (Oh...! This assembly looks really similar to what those neighbor kids used to put together for fun...)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (So then all you have to do is flip the lid here and then...)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: How naive. Weaponry is not something that anyone can simply fiddle with, it takes a certain refinement...... Whaaaat?!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Hold up! Don't cross the lines, it's too dangerous!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: It's fine, it's fine.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: If you don't unplug this, the big guy's gonna be up and running again.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Mm... Wrap this around, and then cut here... Alright, that should do the job. Probably.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: You're just doing random crap in there!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Stop, and listen well, if you don't want an electric shock that pierces your soul, stop what you're doing until I can finish the inspection!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: It's gonna be bad if this thing starts leaking. Well, the damage here is superficial, so it shouldn't be a problem.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: This scratch here, yeah, my last attack caused this. It didn't affect the motherboard, so the risk probably isn't too great...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Ohh, the wiring here is certainly quite interesting. The internal design of the energy device here is rough, but well thought-out.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Huh... Hmm? The movement module seems to have traces of interference. Is this due to the influence of Originium Arts? Also, the part of the wiring responsible for the power supply has been cut...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Are you doooone yet? My hand's getting sore.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: And... I'm falling asleep...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Though I got the big guy to stop moving for now, the most dangerous parts are still untouched...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Darn you... don't tell me, all that stuff you were doing before...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: It was all a part of your plan!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hm? What, you mean this control cable here? Didn't I say everything was fine?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: You should give a senior Rhodes Islander a little credit, newbie.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (Yawn)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Though I might not be as handy a mechanic as some of my clansmen, can't lift a hammer, and can't make a giant out of sheet metal, not being able to build stuff isn't the same as not being able to deal with 'em... And this thing's real simple.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Leaving the question of your clansmen aside for now, you said this thing is... real simple?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Yep. The principles are really simple.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Oi, my red-haired friend, why the skeptical look?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Enough with the red-haired thing! My name's Sesa! At least remember your fellow operators' codenames!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Close enough—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Lemme think, well... Sesa, have you ever seen Myrtle's apple?

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Are you talking about the Arts device that the Engineering Department borrowed to study? That's no ordinary apple...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Yeah, stuff like that's perfectly ordinary to us. You could buy one off the shelf in a corner store.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: What kind of place do you come from?!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hey, it's a perfectly ordinary place—

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: The underground tribe of Durin... I'm sure I've heard someone mention them before...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: That's not too surprising, plenty of us come up to the surface to have some fun.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: If you ask me though—the surface is nice, bright and spacious enough, with lots of interesting things, but the machinery up here's way too primitive.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: In any case... I never knew that Rhodes Island had someone like you around, formidable but willing to hide in the crowd... Hmph, I underestimated you!

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Hah, say no more. You don't need to explain a thing, I already understand. I won't press you for more details about yourself.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: For people like us, this is a fate we must bear... Is that how the saying goes?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (This red-haired tall one isn't very bright.)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (Not that it matters though... *Yawn*... So sleepy...)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (I'm about running on empty here too. After all that exercise, if I don't get some sleep... I might not be able to wake up tomorrow...)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: If I was really as amazing as you make me sound... *yawn*... My folks wouldn't have spent all that time nagging me.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: But I'm frail, always sleepy... Sigh, it's not like I wanted to be like this...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: It seems that your past is also shrouded in mystery.

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Tell you what, based on the fact that we just fought a heart-pounding battle together, I'm willing to listen to your troubles...

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Hey, open your eyes when you walk, you'll trip!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: No way I will. So sleepy... *Yawn*...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: This... is nothing... back home folks nagged so much that I slipped out and came here...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: But... *yawn*... I was born this way. Can't cure it even if you tried...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: ZZZzzzzz

steps.name: Sesa
steps.text: Hey, you're in the middle of a sentence, don't just fall asleep on your feet!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Uhh.... Huh?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (*Stretches*)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (*Yawn*... Did I fall asleep again? Huh, where'd this blanket come from? It's real comfy.)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: (That red-haired tall one... Sesa, I think is his name... He's already gone, huh.)

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: My head hurts a little, what time is it...?
It's getting late, Durin. You slept longer than usual this time.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Oh... Rangers, huh.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I exerted myself a little, so I ended up falling asleep. Couldn't help it.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Pops, were you the one who put the blanket over me? Thanks—

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Oh, I can't take credit for that.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: When this old man came to see you, you were already sound asleep. Aw, you looked so peaceful, I wanted to curl right up there with you.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: *Yaaawn*. The quality of my sleep is nothing to envy, Pops.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Haha, that's true.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: The young'un named Sesa had been sitting here looking after you, talking about how he owes you a favor. Ho ho, what a good kid.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Woah... He didn't just leave? I'm safe enough here on the ship.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: But, hmm. Rhodes Island sure has a lot of nice people.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Haha, we sure do.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: But, Durin, color this old man surprised to hear you went to help him. Why didn't you ask us to deal with it?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: It was easy enough. Just felt like helping a newbie and all...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I've never seen you so enthusiastic about helping.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I'm familiar with that kind of machinery. You usually don't see stuff like it on the surface... Guess you could call it nostalgia.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Fair enough. You're better than us at that sort of thing anyway.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: But enough about that! Um, this blanket here... The next time I see that red-haired tall one, I'll give this back to him.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Oh, and... Pops, what about the barbecue? Don't tell me you guys went and finished everything without me.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I'd never do something like that, and get on your bad side.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Noir Corne is still grilling and left plenty just for you. We were waiting for you to wake up.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Sounds— good—!

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Hey, slow down, be careful not to trip. I've never seen you run that fast.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I slept so well, I'm full of energy.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Durin.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: When I watch you sleep, I can't help but get a bit worried. And I think... the others probably feel the same way.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Your health...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Old— Man—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: *Breathes deeply*

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I'm perfectly fine. Just happened to oversleep a little... What's wrong with that?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Don't worry!

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: I go to Medical for regular check-ups, and I have no trouble with my normal work. Us Durins are tough—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Besides, I can always just blame my condition, and nobody can get mad at me for slacking off during work hours. Isn't that great?

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: And now, if I can just eat a bunch of meat, maybe I'll grow even stronger.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Haha, I suppose...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: ...that you'll have to eat plenty today. Let's go. Noir Corne and the others are waiting.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Woohoo—

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hooray! Barbecue, here I come!
Lack of energy, fatigue and listlessness, illness-prone, and a need for sleep to recover from any amount of exertion — Durin has long gotten used to having such a delicate body.
Congenital deficiency is different from disease and cannot be cured with medicine.
She used to be disgruntled and even angry about it, but when she came to the surface and saw its many stories, Durin came to terms with her physical weakness.
Like...
What does it matter if my body's a bit weaker?
Nothing beats getting sleep free and quiet under the sun during those easy hours of the workday.
